verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a reasonable thing for a search API platform like Exa to ship, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only an MCP server, a JS SDK, and agent skills, none of which is a first-party CLI. The "single command" account setup (exa-docs-33) runs through Stripe Projects, a host-platform tool, so it is not Exa's own CLI and earns no credit.
